relationship_to_protocol_v2.everything_else: unchanged: same 15,203 rows and hashes, seed 42, LoRA r16/alpha16/dropout0 on direct q/k/v/o/gate/up/down, max_seq_length 1024, per_device 8 x grad_accum 2 = effective 16, adamw_8bit lr 2e-4 warmup 5 linear, weight_decay 0.01, bf16, unsloth gradient checkpointing, train_on_responses_only with the same granite markers, greedy decoding 200 max new tokens, identical evaluation sets, identical pre-registered criteria

important_caveat_on_interpretation: epoch-2 is NOT epoch-1 plus one more epoch. The linear LR schedule spans the whole run, so at step 951 this run sits at ~50% of peak LR while the epoch-1 run had decayed to ~0. The optimization trajectory differs from step 6 onward, not only after step 951. This is a fresh training run from the original base checkpoint, NOT a continuation of the epoch-1 adapter. For ministral there is a second reason the epoch-1 loss is not a baseline: that run crashed at step 834/951 and resumed, so its reported 0.017 is a 151-step tail segment, not a full-run loss.
